objective.name: sandbox.dsl.aggregate.params.structure.matter.state
objective.description: Aggregate final params from one structure, one matter, and one read.state response.

#root.role: Create and read one local structure, read one local matter and one local reflexive state, then synthesize final wrapper params from those three sources.

effects.local_structure_materialization: One local structure is created and read.

transformation_contract.morphing: A label becomes one final wrapper payload after structure, matter, and state data are combined into synthesized params.
invariants: The terminal wrapper call receives label from the root input, structure_title from structure.read, matter_message from matter.read, and context_id from read.state.
The flow reads the committed structure after structure.create and does not derive final params from the create response alone.
success: The terminal payload exposes received_params.label, received_params.structure_title, received_params.matter_message, and received_params.context_id.
received_params.context_id matches the local context returned by read.state.
failure: The flow fails if structure.create, structure.read, matter.read, or read.state fails before the terminal wrapper call.
The flow fails if the final wrapper cannot consume the synthesized params.
notes: This scenario is used by N7 to validate mixed aggregation from structure, matter, and reflexive state sources in one DSL flow.
The local structure is created only as test data for the aggregation chain; the terminal result is still wrapper-produced.
